terms.comment: Not ancient — a medieval word kept in the botanical name Citrullus lanatus. Stem quantities are conventional, not attested.
Lewis & Short: “an apple-shaped melon, cucumber-melon”; Pliny’s fruit was not the watermelon, which Traupman gives this name.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 73, 404.
